story.title: The Shadow That Walks Behind You

sentences.text: Have you ever felt someone walking close behind you in the dark?
The old tales say this creature lives among us by day as a quiet neighbor.
Only when the lamps are lit do villagers notice its shadow falls backward.
Our local doctor walked home alone past the whispering rubber trees.
Footsteps matched his stride, growing heavier upon the damp earth.
He turned quickly to look over his shoulder into the empty mist.
A sudden rush of wind knocked the lantern from his trembling hands.
Only a dropped bag remained where the doctor had walked moments before.
Is that soft scratching sound at your wooden door tonight just the wind?
